text.description_html:
Fusion PH-A6, Bronze River Rock Wall Mounted Toilet Tissue Holder

The River Rock Round Mount Toilet Paper Holder is a great example of the beauty of the simplistic. The rich luster of this bronze toilet tissue holder is only enhanced by the two available finishes. Choose from either dark bronze or medium bronze finishes. A wall mounted toilet paper holder, the Fusion made PH-A6 is easy to install and comes with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: Fusion RH-A6 Bronze River Rock Robe Hook, Fusion TB-A6 Bronze River Rock Towel Bar, and Fusion TR-A6 Bronze River Rock Towel Ring

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Bronze Round Radius Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Diameter: 3"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
